newsitem.title: USA: Vector exhausts assets, seeking funds.
newsitem.headline: Vector exhausts assets, seeking funds.

text.p: Vector Aeromotive Corp said Friday that it had exhausted its cash and liquid assets.
The company said it would suspend operations if it was unsuccessful in its efforts to raise additional funds.
In August, Vector said it expected increasing revenue from sales of the M12 sports car, though it still saw further losses in the rest of 1996.
The company made that announcement after reporting second-quarter loss of $1.5 million, or $0.03 per share, compared with a $0.04 per share loss in the year-ago period.
